name: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati (स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती)
popular_title: Kisan Pran (किसान प्राण)
qualifying_benchmark: Founder of Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha 1929, First President of All India Kisan Sabha 1936

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Deva, Ghazipur (Karmabhoomi: Sitaram Ashram, Bihta, Patna), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ka mool naam Naurang Rai tha. Ek Jujhautiya Brahmin parivar mein janme Swamiji ne kishoravastha mein hi sansarik jeevan chhodkar Dashnami Dandi sanyas grahan kiya. Kashi mein Sanskrit aur darshan ke rigorous adhyayan ke dauran unhone dekha ki feudalism aur Brahmanical rituals garib kisanon ke shoshan ka hathiyar ban chuke hain. 1920s mein Bihar aane ke baad Patna ke paas Bihta mein Sitaram Ashram banakar unhone apni sadhana ko agrarian proletariat ke mukti sangharsh mein badal diya. Bihta unke krantikari kisan andolan ka permanent nerve-centre bana.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Bakasht Movement, Anti-Zamindari Struggle, Agrarian Labor Awakening, All India Kisan Mobilization
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Swamiji ne 1929 ke Sonepur mela mein Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) sthapit ki taaki zamindari cesses (abwabs) aur eviction ke khilaf organized ladai ladi ja sake. 1937-39 ke dauran unhone pure Bihar mein historic Bakasht Andolan lead kiya, jahan kisanon ne lathiyon ke bal par zamindaron dwara chhini gayi zameen par fasal kaati aur hal chalaya. Barahiya Tal, Reora aur Amwari jaise sangharshon mein unke netritva ne British Raj aur zamindaron ke gathjod ko hila diya. Unhone Congress leadership ke capitalist-zamindar compromise ke khilaf khulkar stand liya aur subaltern agrarian class ko unified economic class mein convert kiya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Kisan Kya Karen?
Mera Jeevan Sangharsh
Brahman Samaj Ki Sthiti
Kisan Sabha Ke Sansmaran
Gita Hriday
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Swamiji ne 'Kisan Kya Karen?' aur 'Mera Jeevan Sangharsh' jaisi path-breaking kitabein likhin jinhone peasant consciousness ko theoretical aur practical roadmap diya. Unka nikaala journal 'Hunkar' kisan vidroh ka mukhpatra bana jismein Subhash Chandra Bose aur Rahul Sankrityayan jaise diggaj likhte the. Unhone 'Gita Hriday' ke madhyam se Bhagavad Gita ki materialist aur karma-kendrit vyakhya karke shramik varg ko ladne ka aadhyaatmik aadhar diya. Unke dwara sthapit institutions ne post-independence Zamindari Abolition Act 1950 ke liye direct legislative zameen taiyar ki.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kisanon ke adhikar aur rozi-roti ke liye ajeevan sangharsh karne ke karan aam kisan unhein 'Kisan Pran' pukarte the.
April 1936 ke Lucknow Congress session mein All India Kisan Sabha ka gathan aur uske founding President banna.
Bihta (Patna) mein Sitaram Ashram state heritage memorial ke roop mein sanrakshit hai; ICAR dwara unke samman mein national award sthapit hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains ka core question: 'Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha ki sthapna kisne aur kab ki?' tatha 'All India Kisan Sabha 1936 ke pehle adhyaksh kaun the?'

name: Birsa Munda (बिरसा मुंडा)
popular_title: Dharti Aaba (धरती आबा), Bhagwan Birsa
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Commander of Munda Ulgulan (1899–1900), Direct Catalyst for Chota Nagpur Tenancy Act 1908

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Ulihatu village, Khunti district (erstwhile Ranchi/Singhbhum), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Birsa Munda ka janam Ulihatu ke ek garib Munda tribal parivar mein hua tha. Shuruati shiksha German Evangelical Lutheran Mission school (Chaibasa) mein hui jahan unka naam Daud Munda rakha gaya, par christian conversions aur missionary arrogance ke virodh mein unhone school chhod diya. Baad mein Vaishnava darshan aur Munda traditional religion ke contact mein aakar unhone 'Birsait' panth chalaya. Chota Nagpur ke Khuntkatti system (communal land ownership) ko British thekedaron aur Dikus (outsiders) dwara nasht karne aur Beth-begari (forced labor) ke chalan ne unhein armed anti-colonial rebellion ka prabal neta banaya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Munda Ulgulan 1899-1900, Restoration of Khuntkatti Land System, Millenarian Socio-Religious Reform, Anti-Diku Resistance
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Birsa ne 1899 mein British sarkar aur Christian missionaries ke khilaf 'Ulgulan' (The Great Tumult) ka ailan kiya. Unka nishana tha 'Abua Raj Ete Jana, Maharani Raj Tundu Jana' (Munda raj shuru ho, British rani ka raj samapt ho). Unhone Dumbari Buru pahadi ko apna guerrilla headquarters banaya jahan se unke sainikon ne police stations, thekedaron aur zamindaron par teer-kaman se hamle kiye. January 1900 mein Dumbari Buru par British army ke sath hue deadly encounter mein sekdo Munda lade. 3 February 1900 ko Jamkopai forest se unki giraftari hui aur Ranchi Jail mein mysterious circumstances mein unki shahadat hui.

institutions_or_initiatives: Supreme Commander, Munda Armed Guerrilla Force
famous_works_or_edicts: Declaration of Abua Raj ('Abua Disum Re Abua Raj')
Birsait Moral Code against Liquor and Sacrifices
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Birsa ne tribal society ke bheetar social reform chalaya jismein sharab, andhavishwas aur pashu-bali par rok lagayi gayi. Unhone ek naya monotheistic dharshan diya jise Birsait kaha gaya. Unke Ulgulan ka sabse decisive structural output yeh raha ki British administration ko adivasiyon ke zameen adhikar samajhne pade aur 11 November 1908 ko historic 'Chota Nagpur Tenancy Act' (CNT Act) enact kiya gaya, jisne tribal land ko non-tribals dwara transfer karne par legal ban laga diya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Tribal community dwara unki alaukik drishti aur mukti ke prayason ke samman mein 'Dharti Aaba' (Father of the Earth) aur Bhagwan kaha gaya.
9 January 1900 ko Dumbari Buru pahadi par British troops aur Birsa ke sainikon ke beech decisive armed clash.
Ranchi Airport (Birsa Munda Airport); Parliament House ke Central Hall mein unka portrait sthit hai; 15 November unki jayanti par 'Janjatiya Gaurav Divas' manaya jata hai.
BPSC GS-1 Mains & Prelims: 'Birsa Munda ke Ulgulan ke mukhya kaaran kya the?' tatha 'Chota Nagpur Tenancy Act kis varsh pass hua tha? (1908)'.

name: Sidhu Murmu (सिद्धू मुर्मू)
popular_title: Paramount Leader of Santhal Hool
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Commander of Santhal Hool (1855–56), Initiator of Sovereign Santhal Raj at Bhagnadih

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bhagnadih village, Sahibganj district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Sidhu Murmu ka janam Bhagnadih gaon ke ek sanvedansheel Santhal parivar mein hua tha. Chunnu Murmu ke char beton mein ve sabse bade the. 1830s ke dauran Britishers ne Santhals ko Damin-i-Koh region mein janglon ko saaf karke kheti karne ke liye basaya tha, par jaldi hi wahan Bengali aur Marwari Mahajan (moneylenders), British darogas aur zamindaron ne unka asim arthik shoshan shuru kar diya. 50% se 500% tak ke byaj dar, bandhua mazdoori aur izzat par hamlon ne Sidhu ko aatm-raksha aur azaadi ke armed revolt ke liye taiyar kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Santhal Hool 1855, Creation of Santhal Parganas District, Guerrilla Warfare in Rajmahal Hills, Anti-Mahajan Agitation
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 30 June 1855 ko Sidhu ne Bhagnadih mein lagbhag 10,000 Santhals ki aitihasik sabha bulayi. Wahan unhone Thakur ji (Thakur Bonga) ka aadesh sunaya ki zameen unki hai aur British raj ko khatam karna hai. Sidhu ne pure Santhal Pargana, Birbhum aur Bhagalpur mein military campaign chalaya. Unhone railway tracks ukhaad diye, dak-chaukiyan jala din aur corrupt daroga Mahesh Lal Sen ko maar giraya. Major Burroughs ki British force ko Pirpainti ke paas harakar unhone Santhal sovereign power establish ki. Aakhirkar Barhait ke ghaney jangalon mein unhein pakad kar Bhagnadih mein ped par latka kar phansi di gayi.

famous_works_or_edicts: Declaration of Santhal Sovereignty ('Apna Raj')
Sal Tree Branch Transmission (Dharwak) as War Signal
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Sidhu ne communication ke liye 'Sal' ki daal (Dharwak) ko gaon-gaon bhej kar war mobilizer ke roop mein institutionalize kiya. Unhone ek parallel traditional tribal administration banayi jahan Santhal headmen (Manjhi-Parganait) taxes aur criminal justice control karte the. Is revolt ke daman ke baad Britishers ko samajh aaya ki Santhal land alag regulatory framework mangti hai, jiske natijatan Santhal Parganas Tenancy Act (SPTA) aur 1855 ka Act XXXVII pass hua jisse Santhal Parganas ko Non-Regulation district banaya gaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Santhal community ke paramparik spiritual-military supreme head ke roop mein unhein 'Subah' aur Commander-in-Chief ka darja mila.
30 June 1855 ko Bhagnadih mein Santhal Hool ka official ailan (jise har varsh 'Hool Divas' ke roop mein manaya jata hai).
Dumka mein 'Sido Kanhu Murmu University' (SKMU) sthit hai; Bhagnadih mein unka martyrdom memorial banaya gaya hai.
BPSC Mains GS-1 ka classic question: 'Santhal Vidroh (1855-56) ke kaaran aur uske swaroop ki vivechana karein (Sidhu-Kanhu ki bhumika)'.

name: Kanhu Murmu (कान्हू मुर्मू)
popular_title: Field Commander of Santhal Hool
qualifying_benchmark: Joint Supreme Commander of Santhal Hool (1855–56), Strategist of Mass Guerrilla Assaults in Rajmahal Region

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bhagnadih village, Sahibganj district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Kanhu Murmu Sidhu Murmu ke chhote bhai the aur unka palan-poshan Damin-i-Koh ke janglon aur pahadon ke beech hua. Unhone mahajano dwara traditional Santhal farmers ke shoshan ko ankhon se dekha tha. Kanhu ke paas asadharan strategic planning aur armed mobilization skills thin. Jab unke bade bhai Sidhu ne spiritual call diya, tab Kanhu ne use military execution aur troop logistics mein badal diya. Unka mizaaj samjhauta-heen tha aur unhone tribal youth ko conventional weapons (teer, dhanush, bhaley) se modern British army ka samna karne ke liye inspire kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Battle Logistics of Santhal Hool, Coordination of Guerrilla Fronts, Siege of British Outposts
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Kanhu ne 30 June 1855 ke aavhan ke baad troops ko different fronts par divide kiya. Unhone Pakur, Barharwa aur Rajmahal ke ilakon mein British installations aur police thuk-thikano par lightning attacks coordinate kiye. Jab Britishers ne Martial Law lagakar gao ke gao jalana shuru kiya aur 15,000 se adhik Santhals ko shaheed kiya, Kanhu ne guerrilla tactics se British supplies kaati thin. Sidhu ki giraftari ke baad bhi Kanhu ne aakhri dum tak Sangharsh jari rakha. February 1856 mein unhein betray karwake arrest kiya gaya aur Bhagnadih mein aam janta ke samne phansi di gayi taaki khauf failaya ja sake.

institutions_or_initiatives: Military Strategist, Santhal Hool High Command
famous_works_or_edicts: Mobilization Directives sent across Damin-i-Koh
Parwana to British Authorities to quit tribal land
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Kanhu ne Manjhi-Parha network ko war council mein badal kar practical tribal unity create ki. Unke aadesh par hazaron Santhal stri-purush khet chhodkar yuddh ke maidan mein kood pade the. Unka sabse decisive administrative outcome yeh tha ki British Parliament ne Santhal Pargana ke governance ko regulate karne ke liye 'Act XXXVII of 1855' pass kiya, jisne Santhals ko regular civil/criminal courts ke harassment se bahar nikaal kar deputy commissioner ke direct jurisdiction mein laya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Sidhu ke sath milkar Santhal mukti yuddh ka mukhya dharohar hone ke karan unka naam 'Sidhu-Kanhu' ke roop mein ek sath amar hua.
February 1856 mein unki arrest aur Bhagnadih mein public hanging jo Santhal Hool ka final military resistance point bana.
Sido Kanhu Murmu University (Dumka) aur Kolkata mein unke naam par Sido-Kanhu Dahar (Esplanade) sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: '1855 ke Santhal Vidroh ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, Bhairav)'.

name: Chand Murmu (चांद मुर्मू)
popular_title: Field General of Santhal Hool
qualifying_benchmark: Military Marshal of Santhal Hool (1855–56), Martyred in Armed Battle against British Troops

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bhagnadih village, Sahibganj district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Chand Murmu Chunnu Murmu ke teesre bete aur Sidhu-Kanhu ke anuj the. Unka jeevan Damin-i-Koh ke agrarian aur forest terrain ke beech beeta. Unke andar indigenous warfare, archery aur scouting ka gahan gyan tha. Jab 1855 mein British aur diku exploitation ke khilaf baghavat shuru hui, Chand ne communication network aur southern frontline par army supply line maintain karne ki responsibility li. Unka vyaktitva nidar aur practical planning se bhara tha, jisne vidroh ko southern Bengal border tak failne mein sahayata ki.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Southern Division Commander of Santhal Hool, Resistance in Murshidabad-Birbhum Sector
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Chand Murmu ne apne chauthe bhai Bhairav ke sath milkar Murshidabad, Birbhum aur Rajmahal ke seemavarti ilakon mein vidroh lead kiya. Unhone zamindaron ke haveliyon aur East India Company ke stores par attacks organize kiye taaki aam kisanon ke liye anaj aur hathiyar secure kiye ja sakein. Jab Lieutenant Fane aur anya British officers ne advanced rifles ke sath hamla kiya, Chand ne local archery units ke bal par ghaney junglon mein guerrilla entrapment strategy deploy ki. Barhait aur Dulmi ke paas hue ghamsan yuddh mein ve frontline par lade aur veergati ko prapt hue.

institutions_or_initiatives: Southern Strike Force of Santhal Hool
famous_works_or_edicts: Directives to Santhal villages for non-compliance with zamindari cesses
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Chand Murmu ne Santhal Hool ko sirf Bhagnadih tak simit nahi rehne diya balki use multi-directional movement mein badal diya. Unki tactical positioning ki wajah se British army ko lagbhag 6 mahine tak Damin-i-Koh ke southern borders ko seal karne mein nakami jhelni padi. Unke sahas ne aam tribal logon mein yeh vishwas bhara ki British firepower ko indigenous strategies se defeat kiya ja sakta hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Murmu brothers ki chaukadi (Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, Bhairav) ke mukhya senapatiyon mein se ek ke roop mein poojya.
1855 ke aakhri mahinon mein British regiment ke khilaf ladte hue run-kshetra mein martyrdom prapt karna.
Bhagnadih aur Sahibganj mein Murmu brothers ke combined war memorial mein Chand Murmu ka stambha sthit hai.
BPSC State History: 'Santhal vidroh mein shaheed hone wale charon bhaiyon ke naam batayein (Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, Bhairav)'.

name: Bhairav Murmu (भैरव मुर्मू)
popular_title: Field Commander of Santhal Resistance
qualifying_benchmark: Commander of Santhal Hool (1855–56), Supreme Battlefield Martyr against British Imperial Troops

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bhagnadih village, Sahibganj district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Bhairav Murmu Chunnu Murmu ke sabse chhote bete the. Bachpan se hi unhone apne teeno bade bhaiyon (Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand) ke sath tribal resistance ke sankalp ko share kiya. Santhal youth ke beech Bhairav ki image ek energetic, fearless aur direct action leader ki thi. Damin-i-Koh ke pahadi ilakon aur jharanon se parichit hone ke karan ve British cavalries ko chhakane mein mahir the. Unka focus tha ki British soldiers ko plain ground par na ladne dekar unhein ghaney pahadon mein trap kiya jaye.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Guerrilla Offensives in Rajmahal Hills, Tactical Defense of Santhal Strongholds, Anti-Cavalry Traps
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Bhairav ne Chand ke sath milkar British forces ke movement ko disrupt karne ke liye wooden stockades aur traditional obstacles erect kiye. Jab British army ne elephants aur heavy artillery deploy ki, tab Bhairav ne night raids lead ki thin. Barhait ki valley mein jab decisive clash hua, tab Bhairav ne British bullets ka saamna karte hue frontline par direct combat kiya. Ve ladte hue goli lagne se veergati ko prapt hue. Unki shahadat ne Santhal Hool ke moral stature ko amar kar diya.

institutions_or_initiatives: Vanguard Youth Wing of Santhal Hool
famous_works_or_edicts: Battlefield War Cry of Santhal Hool
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Bhairav Murmu ka yogdan Santhal resistance ke youth mobilization mein tha. Unhone mahajano ke documents (bahi-khate) jala kar karza mukti ka physical operation chalaaya. Unki shahadat ke baad British officers ne records mein note kiya ki Santhal ladke aakhri saans tak surrender karne ke bajaye run-kshetra mein ladna pasand karte the, jismein Bhairav ki leadership supreme example thi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Murmu bhrataon ki krantikari dharohar ke frontline field martyr ke roop mein sammanit.
Barhait battle mein direct combat ke dauran British firing mein veergati prapt karna (late 1855).
30 June ko Hool Divas ke avsar par state level par charon Murmu bhaiyon ko combined public homage diya jata hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: 'Bhagnadih sthal ka sambandh kis historic andolan se hai? (Santhal Hool 1855 - Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, Bhairav)'.

name: Phulo Murmu (फूलो मुर्मू)
popular_title: Pioneer Woman Warrior of Santhal Hool
qualifying_benchmark: Pioneer Tribal Woman Commander of Santhal Hool (1855–56), Led Direct Guerilla Night-Raid on Pasra Military Camp

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bhagnadih village, Sahibganj district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Phulo Murmu Chunnu Murmu ki beti aur Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, Bhairav ki behen thin. Santhal tribal society mein mahilaon ki participatory role hamesha se strong rahi hai. Phulo ne bachpan se hi mahajano ke lathayiton aur police darogas dwara Santhal mahilaon par kiye jane wale atyacharon aur shoshan ko dekha tha. Jab unke charon bhaiyon ne azaadi ka bigul phoonka, toh Phulo piche nahi rahin. Unhone apni behen Jhano ke sath milkar Santhal mahilaon ki ek dedicated military aur logistical wing assemble ki.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Female Guerrilla Mobilization, Pasra British Camp Night Attack, Logistics and Intelligence for Santhal Fighters
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Phulo Murmu ne 1855 ke dauran purush yoddhaon ke sath kandhe se kandha milakar ladai ladi. Unka sabse legendary military achievement tha Pasra (Dumka-Godda border) mein sthit British army camp par direct assault. Phulo ne apni behen Jhano aur mahila toli ke sath raat ke andhere mein camp mein infiltrate kiya aur traditional weapons (kulaadi/axe aur talwar) se kayi British soldiers aur mercenaries ko dher kar diya. Is historic attack ne British command ke bheetar khauf paida kar diya ki Santhal vidroh mein mahilayein lethal combatants ban chuki thin.

institutions_or_initiatives: Women's Combat Wing of Santhal Hool
Bhagnadih Food and Medical Supply Network
famous_works_or_edicts: Mobilization of Tribal Women for Armed Resistance
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Phulo Murmu ka role subaltern feminist history ka ek extraordinary milestone hai. Unhone colonial forces ke khilaf physical violence mein direct hissa liya. Unhone Santhal gaonon mein intelligence gathering aur weapons distribution ka network maintain kiya. Unki martyrdom ne yeh establish kiya ki 1855 ka Hool ek total public war (jan-yuddh) tha jismein gender boundaries dissolve ho chuki thin.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Santhal loka-kathaon aur geeton mein unhein 'Veerangana Phulo' aur frontline war-heroine ka status mila.
Pasra British military camp par lethal guerrilla raid jismein unhone direct enemy casualties cause ki thin.
Jharkhand-Bihar kshetra mein 'Phulo-Jhano Aashirwad Abhiyan' aur Dumka Medical College ka naam 'Phulo Jhano Medical College' rakha gaya.
BPSC History & Subaltern Studies: 'Santhal vidroh (1855) mein kin do mahila veeron ne British camp par direct hamla kiya tha? (Phulo aur Jhano Murmu)'.

name: Jhano Murmu (झानो मुर्मू)
popular_title: Warrior Heroine of the Santhal Insurgency
qualifying_benchmark: Co-commander of the Women's Guerilla Unit in Santhal Hool (1855–56), Pasra Camp Raid Veteran

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bhagnadih village, Sahibganj district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Jhano Murmu Chunnu Murmu ke parivar ki beti thin aur Phulo Murmu ke sath inseparable combat pair ke roop mein jani jati hain. Unka parivar Bhagnadih mein Santhal swatantrata ki aag ka kendra tha. Jhano ne dekha ki kaise Damin-i-Koh ke aam Santhal kisanon ki faslein aur aatmasamman loot liya gaya tha. Unke andar indigenous martial skills aur tracking capabilities thin. Unhone tribal mahilaon ko recruit kiya aur unhein self-defense ke sath-sath offensive guerrilla war ke liye trained kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Armed Combat, Infiltration Tactics, Mobilization of Subaltern Peasant Women, Weapon Distribution
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Jhano ne apni behen Phulo ke sath milkar Pasra military camp par historic night operation execute kiya. Unhone traditional axes (tangi) aur bows se camp guards ko eliminate karke ammunition aur food supplies capture ki thin. Iske alawa Jhano ne wounded Santhal rebels ke forest hideouts mein medical aur logistic line secure ki. British repressions ke dauran jab gao ke gao jalaye ja rahe the, Jhano ne mahilaon aur bachhon ko ghaney Rajmahal hills mein refuge organize karwaya aur aakhri dum tak surrendered nahi kiya.

famous_works_or_edicts: War chants of Santhal women during combat
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Jhano Murmu ne 19th century anti-colonial movements mein women's participation ka global paradigm badal diya. Ve passive supporters nahi balki active combatants thin. Unke dwara lead ki gayi unit ne British army supply lines ko Rajmahal aur Dumka ke beech trap kiya. Unki martyrdom unke bhaiyon ke sath hi azaadi ke yagya mein aahuti ke roop mein darj hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Veerangana Phulo-Jhano ki jodi ke roop mein unhein Santhal folklore mein supreme war-heroine mana jata hai.
Pasra British military installation par successful surprise combat attack (1855).
Dumka mein sthit 'Phulo-Jhano Chowk' aur educational institutes unki veerta ke prateek ke roop mein samarpit hain.
BPSC Special Reference: 'Phulo aur Jhano ka sambandh Bihar ke kis aitihasik vidroh se raha hai? (Santhal Hool 1855)'.

name: Gaya Munda (गया मुंडा)
popular_title: Sardar of the Munda Army, Commander-in-Chief of Birsa Ulgulan
qualifying_benchmark: Commander-in-Chief (Sardar) of Birsa Munda's Army (1899–1900), Leader of the Historic Battle of Etke Chero

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Etke Chero village, Khunti district (erstwhile Ranchi), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Gaya Munda ka janam Khunti ke Etke Chero gaon ke ek nishthavan Munda tribal kisan parivar mein hua tha. Unka vyaktitva gambhir, tejaswi aur paramparik hathiyaron ke chalan mein advitiya tha. Unka parivar Khuntkatti zameeno par dakuon aur zamindaron ke kabje se peedit tha. Jab Birsa Munda ne religious aur political andolan shuru kiya, toh Birsa ne Gaya Munda ki organizational capability aur military fearlessness ko pehchan kar unhein apna sabse vishwas-patra commander banaya. Gaya Munda ne Birsa ke sandesh ko combat force mein institutionalize kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Commander-in-Chief of Ulgulan, Battle of Etke Chero, Tactical Planning at Dumbari Buru, Direct Combat with Police Force
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Gaya Munda Ulgulan ki armed wing ke principal Commander-in-Chief the. Unhone 1899 mein Christmas eve par plan kiye gaye coordinated strikes ko design kiya tha. Jab British administration ne Gaya Munda ko pakadne ke liye police contingent bheja, tab 5-6 January 1900 ko unke apne gaon Etke Chero mein unhone police force par seedha hamla bol diya aur Constable Jai Ram ko maar giraya aur British officers ko bhagane par majboor kar diya. Iske baad unhone Dumbari Buru pahadi par supreme defense line banayi. British army ke lathi aur goli attack ke dauran unhone aakhri saans tak talwar aur teer-kaman se mukabla kiya.

institutions_or_initiatives: Supreme Military Council of Munda Ulgulan
famous_works_or_edicts: Military Directives of Munda Guerrillas against British Stations
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Gaya Munda ne Birsa Munda ke spiritual vision ko ground par physical force provide ki. Unhone youth ko jungle warfare, night maneuvering aur target practice mein trained kiya. Unke Etke Chero home defense ne yeh dikha diya ki Munda tribal society ka har ghar ek fortress tha. Unki giraftari aur martyrdom ke baad hi Britishers Dumbari Buru aur Ulihatu ko capture kar sake the.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Bhagwan Birsa dwara unhein Munda sena ka 'Pradhan Senapati' (Sardar) ghoshit kiya gaya tha.
6 January 1900 ko Etke Chero encounter mein British police contingent ko dharashayi karna.
Khunti aur Ranchi mein Gaya Munda smriti sthapanayein aur tribal bravery memorials sthit hain.
BPSC History & Tribal Movements: 'Birsa Munda ke pradhan sainik senapati (Commander-in-Chief) kaun the? (Gaya Munda)'.

name: Manki Munda (मानकी मुंडा)
popular_title: Heroine of Etke Chero, Fierce Woman Warrior of Ulgulan
qualifying_benchmark: Leading Woman Fighter of Munda Ulgulan (1899–1900), Spearheaded the Women's Defense during the British Siege of Etke Chero

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Etke Chero village, Khunti district (erstwhile Ranchi), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Manki Munda Gaya Munda (Birsa Munda ke Senapati) ki dharmapatni thin. Unka poora parivar Ulgulan ke liye samarpit tha. Munda samaj mein striyon ke self-respect aur forest autonomy ke values unke andar koot-koot kar bhare the. Unhone dekha ki kaise British forces aur police gaon mein ghus kar auraton ke sath badsaluki aur zameeno par lootpat karti thi. Manki ne apne pati ke sath milkar ghar ko ek training fort bana diya tha, jahan unki bahuyein aur betiyan bhi lathi, dauli aur bow-arrows chalaney mein expert ban gayi thin.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Battle of Etke Chero (January 1900), Women's Armed Combat in Ulgulan, Imprisonment for Anti-Colonial Sedition
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 6 January 1900 ko jab Deputy Commissioner Streetfield aur police force ne Gaya Munda ke ghar ko gher kar aag laga di, tab Manki Munda ne surrender karne ke bajaye hathiyaron ke sath bahar nikalkar police party par direct attack kiya. Unhone apni bahuon ke sath talwar aur axes se British jawano ko retreat karne par majboor kiya. Is ferocious women-led fight ko British records ne extraordinary courage ke roop mein record kiya. Ghar jal jane ke baad unhein physically overpower karke giraftar kiya gaya aur lambi rigorous imprisonment di gayi.

institutions_or_initiatives: Women's Defense Unit of Etke Chero (Ulgulan)
famous_works_or_edicts: Oral war-cries defying British police surrender demands
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Manki Munda ka role proof karta hai ki Munda Ulgulan ek nuclear family-level revolt tha jahan poora parivar ek sath yuddh mein utar gaya tha. Unhone colonial state ko dikhaya ki tribal mahilayein rifles ke samne axes lekar khadi ho sakti hain. Unki jail yatra aur suffering ne Chota Nagpur ke tribal consciousness mein mahila yoddhaon ka permanent standard banaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Ulgulan folklore mein unhein 'Etke Chero ki Sherni' ke roop mein sammaan diya jata hai.
January 1900 mein apne jalte hue ghar se nikal kar British troops par direct armed resistance karna.
Khunti ke Ulgulan museum aur state archives mein Manki Munda ke bravery documents darj hain.
BPSC Special History: 'Birsa Munda vidroh ke dauran Gaya Munda ki patni ka kya naam tha jinhone hathiyar uthakar sangharsh kiya? (Manki Munda)'.

name: Tilka Manjhi / Jabra Paharia (तिलका मांझी / जबरा पहाड़िया)
popular_title: First Anti-Colonial Tribal Martyr of India, Aadi Vidrohi
qualifying_benchmark: Leader of Paharia Revolt (1780–1785), Assassinated British Collector Augustus Cleveland (1784)

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Tilkapur village, Sultanganj, Bhagalpur district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Tilka Manjhi ka janam Bhagalpur ke Sultanganj ke paas Tilkapur gaon mein ek Santhal/Paharia parivar mein hua tha. Unka mool aadi-naam Jabra Paharia mana jata hai. 1770 ke severe Bengal Famine (chhihattar ka akaal) ke dauran unhone dekha ki lakho log bhookh se mar rahe the par British East India Company ke tax collectors forcefully anaj vasool kar rahe the. Tilka ne Company ke godowns loot kar bhookhe kisanon mein baantna shuru kiya. Is incident ne unhein aam logon ka messiah aur British rule ka sabse pehla tribal enemy bana diya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Paharia Liberation War 1780-85, Guerilla Warfare in Rajmahal Hills, Cleveland Assassination 1784
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Tilka Manjhi ne Rajmahal aur Bhagalpur ke janglon ko apna base banakar East India Company ke khilaf organized guerrilla war chheda. 1784 mein jab British Collector Augustus Cleveland ne tribal logo ko bribe aur divide-and-rule se suppress karne ki koshish ki, tab Tilka Manjhi ne ek taad ke ped par chhip kar Cleveland par zehrila teer chalaya, jisse uski maut ho gayi. Is historic assassination ne British empire ko hilakar rakh diya. Sir Eyre Coote ki command mein heavy army bheji gayi. Tilka ne Tilkapur ke janglon mein mahino tak chhapamar yuddh lada par aakhirkar unhein pakad liya gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Declaration: 'Dharti hamari hai, is par Company ka koi adhikar nahi'
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Tilka Manjhi Bharat ke modern itihas ke 'Aadi Vidrohi' hain, kyunki unhone 1857 se lagbhag 70 saal pehle British rule ko open armed challenge diya tha. Unhone Sal leaf ke zariye sandesh bhej kar pahadi aur santhal communities ko unite kiya. 1785 mein Bhagalpur mein unhein char ghodon se baandhkar ghaseet-te hue laya gaya aur ek vishal bargad (banyan tree) ke ped par latkakar phansi de di gayi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: British hukumat ke khilaf pehla armed aakrosh darj karne ke karan unhein 'Bharat ka Pehla Shaheed' aur 'Aadi Vidrohi' kaha jata hai.
1784 mein British Collector Augustus Cleveland ko teer se maar girana aur 1785 mein Bhagalpur mein unki shahadat.
Bhagalpur University ka naam unke samman mein 'Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University' (TMBU) rakha gaya; unke shahadat sthal par Tilka Manjhi Chowk sthit hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Augustus Cleveland ko kis aadiwasi neta ne teer se maara tha? (Tilka Manjhi)' tatha 'Tilka Manjhi ko kis shahar mein bargad ke ped par phansi di gayi thi? (Bhagalpur)'.

name: Buddhu Bhagat (बुधु भगत)
popular_title: Paramount Leader of Kol Uprising
qualifying_benchmark: Paramount Leader of Kol Uprising (1831–1832), First Tribal Leader with a Direct British Colonial Bounty (Rs 1,000)

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Silagai village, Chanho, Ranchi district, Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Buddhu Bhagat ka janam Ranchi ke Chanho block ke Silagai gaon mein ek Oraon tribal kisan parivar mein hua tha. Chota Nagpur mein us samay Britishers ne non-tribal Muslim thekedaron, Sikh merchants aur Hindu zamindaron ko zameen ke patte dena shuru kiya tha. Traditional 'Parha Panchayat' aur 'Bhuihari' system chhin liya gaya tha. Buddhu Bhagat ek visionary elder the jinki baat pure Chota Nagpur ke Oraon, Munda aur Ho adivasi mante the. Unhone dekha ki traditional tribal dignity ko restore karne ka ek hi rasta hai—foreigners aur thekedaron ko force se bahar nikalna.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Kol Uprising 1831-32, Creation of South-West Frontier Agency (SWFA), Defense of Chota Nagpur Autonomy
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1831 mein jab Singhbhum aur Ranchi mein Kol Vidroh bhadak utha, Buddhu Bhagat ne Silagai ko armed resistance ka central command post banaya. Unke aavhan par hazaron tribal fighters ne teer, talwar aur bhalon ke sath Company ke police posts aur thekedaron ke kothiyon par kabja kar liya. British administration itna darr gaya ki unhone Buddhu Bhagat ko zinda ya murda pakadne par us zamane mein Rs 1,000 ka massive inaam ghoshit kiya. Captain Impey ne 1832 mein heavy force ke sath Silagai ko gher liya. Buddhu Bhagat ne apne beton aur bhaiyon ke sath aakhri dum tak yuddh kiya aur ran-kshetra mein ladte hue shahadat paayi.

institutions_or_initiatives: United Front of Oraon, Munda and Ho clans
famous_works_or_edicts: Decree of total non-payment of rent to alien thikadars
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Buddhu Bhagat ke lead kiye gaye Kol Vidroh ne British administrative structure ko fundamentally re-evaluate karne par majboor kiya. Regulation XIII of 1833 pass kiya gaya jiske tahat regular British laws ko Chota Nagpur se withdraw karke 'South-West Frontier Agency' (SWFA) banayi gayi, jise Non-Regulation area ke roop mein direct Governor-General ke agent dwara govern kiya jane laga. Yeh tribal administrative self-rule ki pehli institutional jeet thi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: British government dwara official colonial cash bounty (inaam) paane wale Chota Nagpur ke pehle revolutionary leader.
February 1832 mein Silagai encounter jahan Captain Impey ki British force ke sath ladte hue Buddhu Bhagat ne veergati paayi.
Silagai (Ranchi) mein unka state memorial sthit hai; har saal February mein state level par unki veerta ko sammanit kiya jata hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: '1831-32 ke Kol Vidroh ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Buddhu Bhagat)' tatha 'Kol vidroh ke parinamswaroop kis administrative agency ka gathan hua tha? (SWFA)'.

name: Jatra Bhagat / Jatra Oraon (जतरा भगत)
popular_title: Prophet of Tana Bhagat Movement, Pioneer of Tribal Satyagraha
qualifying_benchmark: Founder of Tana Bhagat Movement (1914), Pioneer of Non-Violent Agrarian Civil Disobedience against British Rent

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Chingari village, Bishunpur, Gumla district (erstwhile Ranchi), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Jatra Bhagat ka janam Gumla ke Bishunpur block ke Chingari gaon mein ek garib Oraon kisan parivar mein hua tha. 1914 ke dauran unhone deep meditation aur spiritual experience ke baad Dharmesh (God) ka sandesh announce kiya. Us samay World War I shuru ho chuka tha aur British sarkar tribal masses se forceful grain vasooli aur coolie labor karwa rahi thi. Jatra ne spirituality ko agrarian resistance se jod diya. Unhone ghoshna ki ki unhein aadesh hua hai ki Oraon samaj apne paramparik jeevan ko shuddh kare aur Britishers aur zamindaron ko kisi bhi tarah ka tax ya begaari dena band kar de.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Tana Bhagat Movement 1914, No-Rent Campaign, Boycott of Feudal Labor (Beth-begari), Integration with Gandhian National Movement
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Jatra Bhagat ne April 1914 mein Tana Bhagat Andolan shuru kiya. 'Tana' ka matlab tha 'khinchna' (buraiyon ko khinch kar bahar phekna). Unhone British shasan ko rent dena band karne, chaukidari tax ka boycott karne aur zamindaron ke yahan bina payment kaam na karne ka non-violent aadesh diya. Yeh Bharat ka pehla indigenous Tribal Satyagraha tha. British sarkar ne darr kar 1914 mein hi Jatra ko arrest karke jail mein daal diya. Jail mein unpar kade physical torture kiye gaye jiske chalte release hone ke kuch samay baad unka dehavasan ho gaya, par unka movement Gandhi ji ke aane par direct freedom struggle se jud gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Code of Non-Violence, Vegetarianism, and No-Rent Resistance
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Jatra Bhagat ne tribal society ko shakahar, sharab-mukti aur ahinsa par aadharit naya aachar-shastra diya. Unke followers (Tana Bhagats) aage chalkar 1920 ke Non-Cooperation Movement aur Gaya Congress Session (1922) mein Gandhi ji ke sabse disciplined soldiers bane. Tana Bhagats ne tiranga jhanda pakad kar lathiyan khayin par zameen ka tax nahi diya. Unke is tyag ke karan baad mein 1948 mein Bihar Legislative Assembly ne 'Tana Bhagat Agricultural Land Restoration Act' pass kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Oraon samaj mein spiritual reformer aur anti-tax mass movement leader hone ke karan unhein 'Bhagat' (Saint-Leader) kaha gaya.
April 1914 mein Gumla se Tana Bhagat Andolan ki shuruat jismein zamindaron ko lagan dene se open inkar kiya gaya.
Chingari (Gumla) mein unka smarak sthit hai; Tana Bhagat Development Authority unke ideals par karyarat hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Tana Bhagat Andolan ki shuruat kisne aur kab ki thi? (Jatra Bhagat, 1914)' tatha 'Gandhi ji ke satyagraha se judne wala mukhya tribal group kaun sa tha?'

name: Ganga Narayan Singh (गंगा नारायण सिंह)
popular_title: Leader of Ganga Narayan ka Hungama
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Leader of Bhumij Revolt (1832–1833), Shattered British Administration in Manbhum & Dhalbhum

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Bandhdih / Barabhum Raj, Manbhum district (Purulia-Singhbhum border), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Ganga Narayan Singh Barabhum ke royal Bhumij family se taluq rakhte the. Ve Subal Singh ke pote the jinhone 1769 ke Chuar Revolt mein martyrdom paayi thi. British East India Company ne Barabhum mein succession disputes mein interfere karke traditional Ghatwali aur Sardari land tenure systems par aggressive revenue taxes impose kar diye the. Ghatwals (traditional armed border-guards) ki zameenein zamindaron dwara neelam ki ja rahi thin. Ganga Narayan ne is injustice ke khilaf Bhumij (jinhein colonial records mein 'Chuar' kaha jata tha) kisanon ko ekjut kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Bhumij Revolt 1832-33, Annihilation of Madhav Singh, Destruction of British Munsif Courts and Treasuries
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 2 July 1832 ko Ganga Narayan ne corrupt Diwan Madhav Singh ko maar giraya, jo company ki taraf se excessive rent collection karta tha. Iske baad unhone Barabazar town par attack karke kachehri, collectorate aur salt stores jala diye. Is movement ko British records mein 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama' ke naam se darj kiya gaya. Unke sath hazaron Bhumij, Kol aur Ho tribes shamil ho gaye. Unhone British army ko Manbhum ke janglon mein multiple pitched battles mein chhakaya. Aakhirkar Kharsawan ke Thakur Chetan Singh ke fort par attack ke dauran run-kshetra mein ladte hue ve veergati ko prapt hue.

famous_works_or_edicts: Abolition decree on illegal British police taxes in Barabhum
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Ganga Narayan Singh ke vidroh ne British administration ko hilakar rakh diya. Is revolt ke parinamswaroop 1833 mein British sarkar ne 'Regulation XIII of 1833' enact kiya. Iske tahat purane Manbhum, Barabhum aur Dhalbhum ke structure ko abolish karke ek naya district 'Manbhum' banaya gaya jiska headquarter Manbazar (baad mein Purulia) shift kiya gaya, aur local Ghatwals ko land protections restore ki gayi.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: British colonial records aur history manuals mein is vidroh ko official roop se 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama' kaha gaya.
2 July 1832 ko Barabazar par kabja aur British judicial machinery ko complete destroy karna.
Singhbhum aur Manbhum region mein Ganga Narayan Singh ko paramparik aadiwasi swadhinata senani ke roop mein worship kiya jata hai.
BPSC State GK: '1832-33 ke Bhumij Vidroh (Ganga Narayan ka Hungama) ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Ganga Narayan Singh)'.

name: Raghunath Mahato (रघुनाथ महतो)
popular_title: Amar Shaheed, Architect of Chuar Rebellion
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Leader of the First Phase of Chuar Revolt (1769–1778), Coined the Historic Slogan 'Apna Gaon, Apna Raj'

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Gharmura village, Nimdih, Seraikela-Kharsawan (erstwhile Manbhum), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Raghunath Mahato ka janam Nimdih block ke Gharmura gaon mein Kudmi-Mahato kisan parivar mein hua tha. 1765 mein Allahabad Treaty ke baad British East India Company ne Bengal, Bihar aur Orissa ki Diwani hasil ki aur Chota Nagpur ke jungle-mahal ilake mein tax vasooli badha di. Unhone local paiks aur kisanon ki jote-boye khet chheen kar bahari thekedaron ko dena shuru kiya. Raghunath ne dekha ki Company unki zameen, paramparik jungle ke adhikar aur astitva ko mitane par tuli hai, jiske virodh mein unhone indigenous communities ko mobilize kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Chuar Rebellion (Phase 1, 1769), Guerrilla Attacks on British Supply Convoys, Peasant Self-Rule
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1769 mein Raghunath Mahato ne hazaron Kudmi, Santhal aur Bhumij kisanon ke sath milkar British rule ke khilaf baghavat kar di. 1769 mein unhone Dhalbhum ke Falguna mein historic ailan kiya: 'Apna gaon, apna raj; door bhagao bideshi raj'. Unke sainikon ne British tax collectors aur military patrols par teer-kaman aur talwaron se chhapamar hamle kiye. Unhone British supply lines ko Bengal aur Chota Nagpur ke border par kaat diya. 5 April 1778 ko Lottery (Kolkata-Ranchi route) ke paas British army ke sath hue aamne-saamne ke ghamsan yuddh mein ve ladte hue shaheed hue.

famous_works_or_edicts: Historic Slogan: 'Apna Gaon, Apna Raj; Door Bhagao Bideshi Raj' (1769)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Raghunath Mahato ka slogan 'Apna Gaon, Apna Raj' Bharat ke modern history ka sabse pehla documented grassroots swaraj slogan mana jata hai. Unhone yeh clear kiya ki zameen kisan ki hai aur foreign company ko lagan lene ka koi hak nahi hai. Unki shahadat ne aage aane wale sabhi tribal revolts (Tilka Manjhi, Kol aur Santhal uprisings) ke liye revolutionary blueprint provide kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Peasant autonomy aur indigenous sovereignty ka slogan dene ke karan unhein 'Amar Krantikari' kaha gaya.
1769 mein Falguna mela ke dauran 'Apna gaon, apna raj' ka ailan aur 5 April 1778 ko unki shahadat.
Nimdih aur Ranchi mein unki ashwarooh (horse-mounted) statues aur unke shahadat divas par regular state commemorative programs aayojit hote hain.
BPSC History & Peasant Struggles: 'Apna gaon, apna raj; door bhagao bideshi raj naara kis krantikari ne diya tha? (Raghunath Mahato - 1769 Chuar Vidroh)'.

name: Bhukhan Singh (भूखन सिंह)
popular_title: Leader of Chero Peasant Uprising
qualifying_benchmark: Paramount Leader of Chero Uprising in Palamu (1800–1802), Resisted British Land Settlement and Feudal Auctions

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Palamu district (territorial seat of Chero dynasty), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Bhukhan Singh Palamu ke traditional Chero tribal community se aate the. Palamu mein sadiyon se Chero aur Kharwar aadiwasi paramparik swatantrata se kheti karte the. 18th century ke aakhri dashak mein East India Company ne Palamu Raj ke internal matters mein interfere kiya aur kisanon par high agricultural revenues thop diye. Jab kisan payment nahi kar paye toh Company ne unki zameeno ko neelam (auction) karna shuru kar diya. Bhukhan Singh ne is administrative tyranny ke khilaf Chero kisanon ko hathiyar uthane ke liye organize kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Chero Uprising 1800-1802, Guerrilla Resistance in Palamu Forts and Forests, Anti-Auction Movements
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1800 mein Bhukhan Singh ne British rule ke khilaf khuli baghavat ka ailan kar diya. Hazaron Chero aur Kharwar kisan unke sath jud gaye. Unhone company ke munsif courts, thanas aur revenue collection points par hamle kiye. Palamu ke ghaney janglon aur pahadi corridors ka fayda uthakar unhone Colonel Jones aur British forces ko do saal tak bhari mushkil mein daala. British forces unhein jungle mein defeat nahi kar saki. Aakhirkar 1802 mein British troops ne deceit aur massive encirclement se unhein trap kiya aur capture karke phansi de di.

famous_works_or_edicts: Declaration against sale and auction of ancestral tribal tenures
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Bhukhan Singh ka Chero vidroh Palamu ke itihas ka ek turning point tha. Unke execution ke baad bhi Palamu shant nahi hua, jisne aage chalkar 1857 mein Nilambar-Pitambar ke vidroh ka background banaya. Bhukhan Singh ne dikhaya ki tribal agrarian peasantry bina organized state patron ke bhi Company ki standing army se saalon tak lad sakti hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Palamu ke kisan astitva aur Chero parampara ke 'Agradoot Yoddha' ke roop mein aadarit.
1800 se 1802 tak continuous armed insurgency chalana aur 1802 mein British execution.
Palamu ke Daltonganj aur Shahpur Fort areas mein Chero vidroh ke shilalekhon mein unka naam preserved hai.
BPSC State GK: '1800-1802 ke dauran Palamu mein hue Chero Vidroh ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Bhukhan Singh)'.

name: Nilambar (नीलांबर)
popular_title: Bhogta Veer of 1857, Joint Leader of Palamu Rebellion
qualifying_benchmark: Joint Supreme Commander of 1857 Great Revolt in Palamu, Guerrilla Architect against British Raj

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Chemo-Sanya village, Lesliganj, Palamu district, Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Nilambar Palamu ke Bhogta (Chero-affiliated tribal group) community ke mukhya parivar mein janme the. Ve Shivcharan Manjhi ke bete the. British administration ne unke parivar ke traditional jagirdari adhikar chheen liye the aur British officers unke territory par encroachment kar rahe the. Jab May 1857 mein Meerut aur Dinapur mein vidroh bhadak utha, Nilambar ne apne bhai Pitambar ke sath milkar Palamu se British rule ko jad se ukhadne ka sankalp liya aur local Chero-Kharwar-Bhogta fighters ko integrate kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: 1857 Revolt in Palamu, Guerrilla Defense of Shahpur Fort, Siege of Lesliganj, Raids on Coal Mines
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: October 1857 mein Nilambar ne Pitambar ke sath milkar Chainpur aur Shahpur par hamla kiya aur British loyalist Babu Raghubar Dayal Singh ko defeat kiya. 21 October 1857 ko unhone Lesliganj par hamla karke British thana aur offices ko destroy kar diya. Unhone Rajhara coal mines par kabja karke British commercial machinery thapp kar di. Major Dalton aur Captain Graham ne massive army lekar Palamu par hamla kiya. Nilambar ne ghaney janglon mein mahino tak guerrilla warfare chalaya. Aakhirkar apno ke vishwasghaat se unhein pakda gaya aur 28 March 1859 ko Lesliganj mein aam ke ped par phansi di gayi.

famous_works_or_edicts: Manifesto of Sovereign Tribal Rule in Palamu (1857)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Nilambar-Pitambar ne 1857 ke movement ko Bihar ke southern tribal belt mein ek mass people's war mein badal diya tha. Veer Kunwar Singh ke sath unka indirect tactical coordination tha. Unhone British forces ko do saal tak Palamu ke interior parts mein enter nahi hone diya. Unka ye sangharsh tribal rights aur national freedom ka combined struggle tha.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 1857 ke swatantrata yuddh mein Palamu ke 'Mahan Krantikari Senani' ke roop mein sammanit.
21 October 1857 ko Lesliganj par kabja aur 28 March 1859 ko Lesliganj mein public hanging.
Palamu ke Medininagar mein sthit 'Nilamber-Pitamber University' (NPU); Lesliganj ka naam unke samman mein Nilambar-Pitambar Pur kiya gaya.
BPSC Prelims: '1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Palamu kshetra mein netritva kisne pradan kiya tha? (Nilambar aur Pitambar)'.

name: Pitambar (पीतांबर)
popular_title: Bhogta Revolutionary Hero of 1857
qualifying_benchmark: Joint Leader of 1857 Great Revolt in Palamu, Co-architect of the Fall of Lesliganj Outpost

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Chemo-Sanya village, Lesliganj, Palamu district, Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Pitambar Nilambar ke chote bhai aur strategic partner the. Unka palan-poshan Palamu ke forested aur mountainous terrain mein hua tha. Unhein local geography, cave networks aur guerrilla tactics ki master knowledge thi. Jab British company ne unke parivar ke traditional rights invalidate kiye, Pitambar ne local youth ko archery aur musket warfare mein train karna shuru kiya. 1857 mein jab pure Bihar mein Kunwar Singh aur Amar Singh lade, Pitambar ne Palamu front ko invincible bana diya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: 1857 Guerilla Warfare, Logistics of Palamu Rebels, Defense against Dalton's Regiments
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Pitambar ne Nilambar ke sath milkar British stations aur communication networks ko paralyze kiya. Unhone Sherghati route par British transports par raids lead kiye taaki enemy arms capture kiye ja sakein. November 1857 mein unhone Commissioner Dalton ki advance columns ko multiple chhapamar attacks se slow down kiya. 1858 ke dauran jab British forces ne unke village Chemo-Sanya par aag laga di, unhone pahadon se ladai continue rakhi. February 1859 mein unhein betrayal ke chalte arrest kiya gaya aur 28 March 1859 ko apne bhai Nilambar ke sath hi Lesliganj mein phansi par chadha diya gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Proclamations calling upon Chero-Kharwar tribes to resist company taxes
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Pitambar ka sabse bada yogdan tactical flexibility mein tha. Unhone regular troops ke frontally attack na karke unki supply lines aur information scouts ko neutralize kiya. Nilambar-Pitambar ki shahadat ne Palamu ke aam aadiwasiyon ke dilon mein anti-British consciousness ko permanent bana diya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Nilambar-Pitambar ki amar krantikari jodi ke roop mein poore Bihar-Jharkhand mein poojya.
28 March 1859 ko Lesliganj (Palamu) mein ek sath dono bhaiyon ko phansi par latkaya jana.
Nilamber-Pitamber University (Medininagar) aur state war memorial functions mein unki joint memory immortalized hai.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: 'Palamu ke Bhogta neta Nilambar aur Pitambar ko kis sthan par phansi di gayi thi? (Lesliganj, 1859)'.

name: Raja Arjun Singh (राजा अर्जुन सिंह)
popular_title: Rebel King of Porahat, Protector of Chaibasa Mutineers
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Leader of 1857 Armed Revolt in Singhbhum, Mobilized Ho and Kol Tribes against British Empire

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Porahat, West Singhbhum district, Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Raja Arjun Singh Porahat ke traditional ruler the, jinki Singhbhum ke Ho, Munda aur Kol tribal community ke bheetar asadharan spiritual aur administrative respect thi. Unke parivar ne British supremacy ko reluctant terms par accept kiya tha par unka dil indigenous autonomy ke sath tha. September 1857 mein jab Chaibasa ke Ramgarh Battalion ke sepoy vidroh karke bahar nikle, tab British Commissioner ne Arjun Singh ko unhein surrender karwane ka aadesh diya. Arjun Singh ne foreign rulers ka aadesh man-ne ke bajaye mutineers ko protect kiya aur swayam baghavat ka neta ban gaye.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: 1857 Singhbhum Rebellion, Ho Tribal Mobilization, Battle of Mogra River, Guerrilla Warfare in Saranda Forest
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Raja Arjun Singh ne 1857 ke vidroh mein 20,000 se adhik Ho aur Kol yoddhaon ko mobilize kiya. Unhone Chaibasa se baghi sipahiyon ko Sanjay River paar karwa kar sharan di. Jab British Captain Birch ne Porahat par hamla kiya, tab Arjun Singh ne Saranda ke vishal janglon ko apna fortress banaya. Unke sainikon ne British forces ko Mogra aur Sanjay river ke kinare multiple bloody clashes mein retreat karne par majboor kiya. Unhone 1857 se lekar 1859 tak Britishers ko Singhbhum mein chain se rehne nahi diya. Aakhirkar unhone apne logoko mass starvation aur massacre se bachane ke liye Mayurbhanj ke Raja ke madhyam se surrender kiya aur unhein Banaras mein lifelong house arrest mein rakha gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Proclamation of Indigenous Autonomy from Porahat Fort
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Raja Arjun Singh ne yeh establish kiya ki 1857 ka movement sirf sepoys ka mutiny nahi tha, balki indigenous kings aur tribal masses ka joint anti-imperialist yuddh tha. Unhone Saranda ke impenetrable sal forests ka use warfare strategy ke roop mein kiya. Unke surrender ke baad Britishers ne unka rajya confiscate kar liya par unhone marte dum tak British pension lene se inkar kar diya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Singhbhum ke aadiwasi samaj dwara unhein unki nyayik nishtha ke karan 'Singhbhum ke Mukti Nayak' ke roop mein dekha gaya.
Chaibasa ke rebel Indian soldiers ko rescue karke British administration ke khilaf khula yuddh ghoshit karna (September 1857).
Chaibasa aur Chakradharpur mein unki smriti mein memorials hain; Banaras mein unka nirvasan sthal historic site hai.
BPSC Prelims: '1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Singhbhum kshetra mein aadiwasiyon ko ekjut karke kisne netritva kiya tha? (Porahat ke Raja Arjun Singh)'.

name: Poto Ho / Poto Sardar (पोटो हो / पोटो सरदार)
popular_title: Lion of Serengsia, Hero of Kolhan Independence
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Commander of Ho Tribal Armed Resistance against British East India Company in Kolhan (1837)

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Rajabasa village, Jagannathpur, West Singhbhum district, Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Poto Ho West Singhbhum ke Rajabasa gaon ke ek bahadur Ho tribal warrior the. Kolhan region sadiyon se swatantra raha tha aur wahan ke Ho logoko 'Larka Kol' (Fighting Kols) kaha jata tha kyunki unhone Mughal ya Maratha kisi ki bhi adheenta sweekar nahi ki thi. 1836-37 mein Captain Armstrong aur British forces ne Kolhan mein force ghusayi taaki British suzerainty impose ki ja sake aur local Manki-Munda traditional governance ko destroy kiya ja sake. Poto Ho ne apne gaon aur clan ke astitva ki raksha ke liye teer-kaman uthane ka ailan kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Kolhan Resistance 1837, Battle of Serengsia Ghati, Defense of Manki-Munda Traditional Governance System
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: November 1837 mein Poto Ho ne Serengsia Ghati mein British forces ke advance ko rokne ke liye ambush plan kiya. Is historic Battle of Serengsia Ghati mein unke tribal yoddhaon ne dense rocks aur pedon ke piche se British troops par lethal poisoned arrows ki baarish kar di, jismein kayi British soldiers aur officers mare gaye. Is bloody confrontation ne British military advance ko temporarily shock kar diya. Heavy reinforcements aane ke baad British army ne Rajabasa aur nearby villages ko aag laga di. Poto Ho ko betrayed karke capture kiya gaya aur 1 January 1838 ko Jagannathpur mein saikdon gaonwalon ke samne phansi par latka diya gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Directives to Ho clans to defend Mankipatti autonomy against British troops
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Poto Ho ke balidan ne Britishers ko majboor kiya ki ve Ho logon par direct regular British laws impose na karein. Is revolt ke directly baad British administrator Thomas Wilkinson ne 'Wilkinson's Rule' (1837) enact kiya, jiske tahat Kolhan ko 'Kolhan Government Estate' banaya gaya aur traditional Manki-Munda system ko civil aur judicial powers officially recognise ki gayi, jo aaj tak Kolhan mein effective hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kolhan ki azaadi ke liye supreme balidan dene ke karan unhein 'Serengsia ka Sher' aur Poto Sardar kaha jata hai.
November 1837 mein Serengsia Ghati encounter aur 1 January 1838 ko unka public execution.
Serengsia Ghati (Jagannathpur) mein unka Shahid Sthal sthit hai; Jharkhand sarkar unke samman mein 'Poto Ho Khel Vikas Yojana' chalati hai.
BPSC History & Tribal Revolts: '1837 mein Kolhan kshetra mein British shasan ke khilaf Serengsia Ghati yuddh kis aadiwasi veer ne lada tha? (Poto Ho / Poto Sardar)'.

name: Diva Soren (दिवा सोरेन)
popular_title: Pahadi Senani, Kolhan Krantikari
qualifying_benchmark: Joint Commander of Diva-Kisun Tribal Revolt (1872) against British Forest Encroachment in Porahat

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Matkombera village, West Singhbhum (Porahat region), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Diva Soren ka janam Porahat estate ke Matkombera gaon mein ek Santhal-Ho kisan parivar mein hua tha. Chota Nagpur aur Singhbhum ke dense forested pockets mein unka bachpan beeta jahan traditional communal rights aur forest autonomy par British forestry regulations aur feudal rent contracts thope ja rahe the. Unke mama Kisun Soren swayam paramparik shastron aur indigenous martial skills ke jankar the. British colonial officers aur Porahat ke pro-British Raja dwara aadiwasi zameeno par boundary pillars lagane aur sal forests ke cutting par ban lagane ke virodh mein Diva ne kisan yuvakon ko organize karna shuru kiya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Porahat Forest Uprising 1872, Boycott of Colonial Forest Laws, Anti-Feudal Tax Resistance
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1872 ke dauran Diva Soren ne apne mama Kisun Soren ke sath milkar Singhbhum ke Porahat ilake mein British rule ke khilaf khula armed vidroh chhed diya. Unhone ghoshna ki ki zameen aur jungle Thakur Bonga ke hain aur British officers ko lagan lene ka koi kanooni hak nahi hai. Unhone local youth ki guerrilla units banayi jinhone colonial police chaukis aur Raja ke tehsildaron par teer-kaman se lethal raids execute kiye. British troops ko Porahat ke ghaney janglon mein mahino tak chhapamar yuddh se preshan kiya. Aakhirkar treacherous betrayal ke chalte unhein arrest karke trial ke baad British jail mein qaid rakha gaya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Oral War Decrees asserting customary forest and land rights against Porahat Raj
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Diva Soren ne Singhbhum ke tribal peasants ke bheetar territorial sovereignty ki traditional concept ko institutionalize kiya. Unhone diku zamindaron ke forced extraction network ko disrupt karne ke liye gaon-gaon Sal branches bhej kar collective village assembly system organize kiya. Unke sangharsh ne aage chalkar Chota Nagpur forest rights agitation aur Kolhan government estate regulations ke formulation ko strongly influence kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Singhbhum ke traditional folklore mein Diva-Kisun ki amar krantikari jodi ke roop mein unhein loka-nayak ka darja mila.
1872 mein Porahat forest reservation policies ke khilaf armed guerrilla offensive lead karna.
West Singhbhum mein unke shahadat sthal par annual memorial sabhayein organize hoti hain.
BPSC Tribal Movement section: '1872 mein Singhbhum/Porahat kshetra mein Diva-Kisun vidroh kis issue ke khilaf shuru hua tha? (Forest rights & colonial feudal rent)'.

name: Kisun Soren (किसुन सोरेन)
popular_title: Margdarshak of Diva-Kisun Insurgency
qualifying_benchmark: Joint Leader and Chief Strategist of Diva-Kisun Rebellion (1872) in Singhbhum

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Gumra village, West Singhbhum (Singhbhum border), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Kisun Soren Singhbhum border ke Gumra gaon ke ek paramparik Santhal tribal sanrakshak the. Ve Diva Soren ke mama aur mentor the. Unka parivar traditional archery, medicinal herbs aur local mountain corridors ka bejod gyan rakhta tha. Porahat Raj aur British East India Company ke successor administration ne jab jungle-mahal belt mein forest produce extraction par tax lagaya aur aadiwasiyon ko begari karne par majboor kiya, tab Kisun Soren ne apne bhanje Diva ke sath milkar resistance blueprint banaya. Unka vision forest villages ko direct colonial control se swatantra rakhne ka tha.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Porahat Insurgency Logistics, Tactical Ambush Formations, Mobilization of Subaltern Peasantry
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Kisun Soren ne 1872 ke vidroh mein supreme strategic strategist ka role nibhaya. Unhone Porahat, Chakradharpur aur Chaibasa ke interior forest routes par British supply convoys ko block karne ke liye guerrilla chhapamar strategies design ki. Jab British paramilitary forces ne advance kiya, Kisun ne troops ko rocky ravines mein trap kiya. Unhone Porahat Raja ke un officers ko punish kiya jo British troops ko logistic guide provide karte the. Unki tactical positioning ke chalte British force ko multiple battalions deploy karni padi. Aakhirkar unhein Diva ke sath capture kiya gaya aur severe colonial confinement jhelni padi.

famous_works_or_edicts: Directives to Ho and Santhal clans to boycott forced unpaid labor (Beth-begari)
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Kisun Soren ne inter-tribal solidarity (Santhal, Ho aur Munda) ko single military platform par lakar colonial extraction ke khilaf khada kiya. Unhone local headmen (Manki aur Munda system) ko mobilize karke court summon documents ko burn karwaya. Unka movement Chota Nagpur tenancy aur forest preservation movements ka ek critical historical pre-cursor sabit hua.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Porahat kshetr ke folklore mein unhein Diva Soren ke supreme military adviser aur krantikari guru ke roop mein aadar mila.
1872 ke armed defiance ke dauran British forest outposts aur Porahat revenue kachehris par organized assaults.
Singhbhum region mein Diva-Kisun Jayanti aur martyrdom programs tribal organizations dwara aayojit hote hain.
BPSC Special Reference: 'Diva-Kisun Vidroh (1872) ka mukhya geographical center kaun sa zila tha? (Singhbhum)'.

name: Telanga Kharia (तेलंगा खड़िया)
popular_title: Kharia Veer, Jodiya Panchayat ke Janak
qualifying_benchmark: Commander of Kharia Armed Tribal Resistance (1850s–1880), Established Indigenous Jodiya Panchayats

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Murgu village, Sisai, Gumla district (erstwhile Ranchi), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Telanga Kharia ka janam Gumla ke Sisai block ke Murgu gaon mein ek kisan Kharia tribal parivar mein hua tha. Unke pita Dhuniya Kharia Nagvanshi Raja ke yahan administrative paramparaon se parichit the. Telanga ne bachpan se hi British colonial intrusion, non-tribal zamindaron dwara ancestral lands ki chhin-jhapat aur beth-begari ko deeply mehsus kiya. Unhone traditional tribal assembly system ko restructure karke ek armed self-governance model build karne ka sankalp liya jisse colonial state ki legal authority ko direct challenge kiya ja sake.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Kharia Armed Resistance (1850-1880), Boycott of British Courts, Foundation of Jodiya Panchayat System
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Telanga Kharia ne 1850 ke dashak se lekar 1880 tak British Raj aur local zamindaron ke khilaf unbroken guerrilla war lada. Unhone Gumla, Simdega aur Ranchi ke ilakon mein 13 'Jodiya Panchayats' (indigenous autonomous village councils) establish ki. In Panchayats ne British courts aur police thanas ka complete boycott ghoshit kiya aur parallel administrative courts chalayi. Unhone aadiwasi yuvakon ko lathi, talwar aur archery training ke liye akhade setup kiye. 23 April 1880 ko jab ve Sisai mein training camp ke dauran prayer kar rahe the, tab Bodhan Singh naamak British agent ne unhein peeth piche se goli maarkar unki hatya kar di.

famous_works_or_edicts: Decree of Complete Tax Refusal to British Agents and Expulsion of Middlemen
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Telanga Kharia ka sabse bada sansthagat aavishkar 'Jodiya Panchayat' thi. Is system ne judicial, executive aur military powers village elders ke hath mein wapas de di. British taxation machinery ko unke kshetr mein ghusne se rok diya gaya tha. Unke dwara institutionalize kiya gaya indigenous legal resolution framework aage chalkar customary tribal self-rule bodies ke liye standard bana.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kharia aadiwasi samaj dwara unhein aatmasamman aur swashasan ke supreme icon ke roop mein 'Kharia Veer' kaha gaya.
23 April 1880 ko Sisai training camp mein prayer ke dauran unki shahadat hona.
Sisai (Gumla) mein unka samadhi sthal 'Telanga Toppa Tand' state protected heritage site hai.
BPSC State GK: 'Telanga Kharia ne British shasan ke samantar swashasan ke liye kis sanstha ka gathan kiya tha? (Jodiya Panchayat)'.

name: Bhagirath Manjhi (भागीरथ मांझी)
popular_title: Babaji, King of the Santhals (Kherwar Movement)
qualifying_benchmark: Founder of Historic Kherwar (Safahor) Movement (1874), Initiated Landmark Peasant No-Rent Agitation

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Tardiha village, Godda district (Santhal Parganas), Undivided Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Bhagirath Manjhi ka janam Godda ke Tardiha gaon ke ek sanvedansheel Santhal kisan parivar mein hua tha. 1855 ke Santhal Hool ke brutal suppression ke baad bhi Santhal Parganas mein mahajani exploitation aur settlement survey officers dwara rent hiking jari thi. 1874 ke severe famine ke dauran Bhagirath Manjhi ne spiritual purification aur social equality ko peasant liberation se joda. Unhone traditional tribal origin 'Kherwar' identity ko punarjeevit kiya aur aadiwasi kisanon ko aatm-samman ke sath British oppression ke khilaf khada hone ke liye prerna di.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Kherwar Movement 1874, Non-Violent Agrarian Tax Boycott, Spiritual Subaltern Reformation
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1874 mein Bhagirath Manjhi ne Godda aur Santhal Pargana ke hazaron kisanon ko organize karke unhein 'Kherwar' ghoshit kiya aur swayam ko unka Raja declare kiya. Unhone aadesh diya ki koi bhi Santhal kisan British sarkar ya zamindar ko ek paisa bhi lagan nahi dega kyunki zameen unke purvajon ki hai. Unhone gaon-gaon jakar parallel panchayats sthapit ki aur khud revenue collect karke social grain reserves create kiye. British administration ne darr kar unhein sedition ke aarop mein arrest kiya aur do saal ki rigorous imprisonment di. Unka movement Santhal agrarian resistance ka turning point bana.

famous_works_or_edicts: Proclamation: 'No tax shall be paid to the Zamindars or the British Sirkar'
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Bhagirath Manjhi ne Kherwar andolan ke tehat 'Safahor' (pure people) doctrine di, jismein clean living, monotheism (Singbonga worship) aur complete political independence integrated thi. Unhone dikhaya ki bina violence ke bhi mass civil disobedience ke dam par colonial revenue system ko paralyze kiya ja sakta hai, jisne baad ke Gandhian satyagrahon ke liye grassroots psychological foundation ready kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Santhal kisanon dwara unki spiritual authority aur leadership ke karan unhein 'Babaji' aur Kherwar Raja kaha gaya.
1874 ke famine ke dauran British collectors ko open challenge dekar no-rent movement shuru karna.
Godda aur Dumka mein Bhagirath Manjhi memorial gates aur statues sthit hain; Santhal Pargana mein unki jayanti celebrate hoti hai.
BPSC Prelims: '1874 ke prasiddha Kherwar Andolan ke sansthapak kaun the? (Bhagirath Manjhi)'.

name: Karyanand Sharma (कार्यानंद शर्मा)
popular_title: Hero of Barahiya Tal, General of Peasant Struggles
qualifying_benchmark: Leader of Historic Barahiya Tal Bakasht Movement (1936–1939), Premier Leader of Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha & CPI

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Sahoor village, Lakhisarai (erstwhile Munger district), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Karyanand Sharma ka janam Lakhisarai ke Sahoor gaon mein ek garib kisan parivar mein hua tha. Unhone kadi mehnat se Hindi aur Sanskrit ki shiksha li aur shuruat mein primary school teacher bane. 1920 mein Gandhi ji ke Asahyog Andolan se prerit hokar unhone naukri chhod di aur freedom movement mein shamil ho gaye. Munger aur Tal ilake ke zamindaron ke ruthless lathait-raj aur sharecroppers ke land alienation ne unhein radical peasant struggles ki taraf moda. Ve Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ke sabse trusted field commander bane.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Barahiya Tal Bakasht Satyagraha (1936-39), Peasant Volunteer Brigades, Communist Movement in Bihar
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Karyanand Sharma ne 1936 se 1939 ke dauran Munger ke Barahiya Tal ilake mein lagbhag 14,000 bigha Bakasht zameen par kisanon ke eviction ke khilaf militant satyagraha lead kiya. Zamindaron ke armed attacks, police firings aur bayonets ka saamna karte hue unhone kisan striyon aur purushon ke jatthon ke sath khet par direct hal chalaya aur fasal kaati. Unhein saalon tak Munger aur Hazaribagh jailon mein band rakha gaya jahan unhone continuous hunger strikes lead ki. Unke dabav mein Bihar Provincial Government ko 'Bakasht Land Restoration Act' frame karne ke liye direct mediation commission banana pada.

institutions_or_initiatives: Communist Party of India (Bihar State Secretary)
famous_works_or_edicts: Directives for Peasant Resistance in Tal and Diara Belts
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Karyanand Sharma ne kisan andolan ko sirf peaceful resolutions tak simit na rakhkar direct militant field-action mein badal diya. Unhone sharecroppers aur agricultural laborers ka joint front banaya. Azaadi ke baad ve Bihar mein Communist movement ke pradhan stambha bane aur Bihar Legislative Assembly mein unhone poor tenants ke land ceiling aur tenancy security par historic interventions diye.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Barahiya Tal ke landmark victory ke baad kisan jagat mein unhein 'Tal ka Sher' aur Kisan General ke roop mein sammaan mila.
1936-1939 ka Barahiya Tal Satyagraha jo British Bharat ke sabse lambe chale agrarian satyagrahon mein se ek tha.
Lakhisarai mein Karyanand Sharma Smriti Bhawan aur Sahoor gaon mein state-sponsored commemorative programs sthit hain.
BPSC Prelims & Mains: 'Munger ke Barahiya Tal Bakasht Andolan ka netritva kisne kiya tha? (Karyanand Sharma)'.

name: Yadunandan (Jadunandan) Sharma (यदुनंदन शर्मा)
popular_title: Hero of Reora, Kisan Senapati of Gaya
qualifying_benchmark: Supreme Leader of Historic Reora Bakasht Satyagraha (1938–1939), Secured 850 Bighas for Tenants

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Majhiawan village, Tikari, Gaya district, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Yadunandan Sharma ka janam Gaya ke Tikari kshetra ke Majhiawan gaon mein ek sadharan kisan parivar mein hua tha. Gaya zila us daur mein powerful feudal estates (jaise Tikari Raj) ke coercive exploitation ke liye badnaam tha, jahan kisanon se daanabandi, begari aur exorbitant rent vasoola jata tha. Yadunandan Sharma ne Sanskrit mein achhi shiksha arjit ki aur Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ke contacts mein aaye. Unhone dekha ki Bina organized armed self-defense aur mass mobilization ke Magadh ke semi-feudal structure ko hilaana asambhav hai.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Reora Bakasht Satyagraha 1938-39, Non-Violent Land Capture, Direct Struggle against Tikari Raj
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1938 ke aakhir mein Jadunandan Sharma ne Gaya ke Reora gaon mein historic Bakasht Satyagraha shuru kiya. Tikari Raj ke zamindaron ne kisanon ki zameen ko Bakasht declare karke unhein bedakhal kar diya tha. Sharma ji ne hazaron kisanon ko red flags lekar khet par deploy kiya. Police ne unpar brutally lathicharge kiya aur unhein severely injure karke jail mein daal diya. Jail ke andar se unhone hunger strike ki. Movement itna prachand ho gaya ki district administration ko jhukna pada aur 1939 mein ek historic compromise ke tahat kisanon ko lagbhag 850 bigha zameen par occupancy rights allot karne pade.

famous_works_or_edicts: Tracts on Peasant Resistance against Tikari Raj and Land Resumption
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Jadunandan Sharma ne Magadh belt mein Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha ki building khadi ki. Reora Satyagraha Bharat ke modern peasant history ka ek aisa rare battle tha jahan sharecroppers ne zamindari administrative authority ko directly overturn karke legal land title wapas snatch kiye. Unhone subaltern kisanon ko lathiyon aur self-respect ke dam par ladna sikhaya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Magadh ke kisanon dwara unhein 'Reora ka Nayak' aur Swami Sahajanand ka dharohar-senapati kaha gaya.
1939 mein Reora Satyagraha ke settlement ke tahat 850 bigha zameen kisanon ko restore karwana.
Reora (Gaya) mein Yadunandan Sharma Kisan Smriti Sthal sthit hai jahan regular peasant assemblies hoti hain.
BPSC Prelims: 'Gaya ke Reora mein Bakasht Satyagraha (1938-39) ka netritva kis neta ne kiya tha? (Yadunandan Sharma)'.

name: Pandit Rahul Sankrityayan (पंडित राहुल सांकृत्यायन)
popular_title: Mahapandit (महापंडित)
era_category: Peasant & Tribal Movement / Freedom Struggle / Art & Culture
qualifying_benchmark: Led Historic Amwari Bakasht Satyagraha (1939–1940) in Saran, Sahitya Akademi Award 1958, Padma Bhushan 1963

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Kanaila village, Azamgarh (Karmabhoomi: Saran, Patna & Nalanda), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Mool naam Kedarnath Pandey. Ek Sanatani Brahmin parivar mein janme Rahul ji ne shuruat mein formal university degrees nahi li par 36 languages seekhin. Arya Samaj aur Buddhism ke baad ve Marxist materialist bane. Bihar Research Society aur K.P. Jayaswal ke contact mein aane ke baad Patna aur Saran unki intellectual aur krantikari karmabhoomi bane. Saran ke kisanon ke daily struggles ne unke andar ke scholar ko frontline field agitator bana diya. Ve Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ke close comrade the.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Amwari Satyagraha 1939-40, Peasant Literature in Bhojpuri, Tibetan Manuscript Recovery, Anti-Imperialism
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: 1939 mein Saran zile ke Amwari gaon mein unhone Bakasht zameen par kisanon ke kabje ke liye militant satyagraha lead kiya. Zamindaron ke gundon ne unpar lathiyon se aamne-saamne lethal attack kiya jismein unka sar phat gaya aur khoon behne laga. Sar par patti baandhkar unhone khet par hal chalana jari rakha. Unhein giraftar karke Hazaribagh jail bheja gaya jahan unhone continuous lekhani jari rakhi. Unhone Communist movement ko Bihar ke rural pockets mein deepen karne ke liye kisan morcho ko lead kiya.

famous_works_or_edicts: Volga Se Ganga
Madhya Asia Ka Itihas
Ghummakkad Shastra
Bhojpuri Plays: Naya Shivala & Jonk
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Rahul ji ne peasant literature ko revolutionary weapon banaya. Unhone Bhojpuri mein 'Naya Shivala' aur 'Jonk' jaise natak likhe jinhone gaon ke unpadh kisanon ko zamindari shoshan ke biological reality se rubaru karwaya. Unki classical kitab 'Volga Se Ganga' historical materialism ka master text hai. Unhone Tibet se hazaron durlabh Buddhist palm-leaf manuscripts khachharon par laad kar Patna Museum ko donate kiye.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Unki asadharan multi-disciplinary scholarship aur 36 bhashaon par command ke chalte unhein 'Mahapandit' ki upadhi mili.
1939 mein Saran ke Amwari Bakasht Satyagraha ke dauran severely wounded hokar bhi satyagraha na chhodna.
Patna Museum mein 'Rahul Sankrityayan Collection' sthit hai; 1963 mein Bharat sarkar dwara Padma Bhushan se sammanit hue.
BPSC Prelims: 'Saran zile ke Amwari mein Bakasht Satyagraha kisne lead kiya tha? (Rahul Sankrityayan)' tatha 'Volga Se Ganga ke lekhak kaun hain?'

name: Jamuna Karjee (जमुना कारजी)
popular_title: Agni-Kalam of Peasant Press
qualifying_benchmark: Co-founder & Chief Editor of Landmark Peasant Organ 'Hunkar' (1940), General Secretary of BPKS

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Pusa, Samastipur district (erstwhile Darbhanga), Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Jamuna Karjee ka janam Samastipur ke Pusa kshetra ke ek kisan parivar mein hua tha. Pusa mein unhone British Agricultural Research Institute ke administrative setup aur European indigo planters ke remnants ko dekha. Unhone journalism aur kanoon ka gyan arjit kiya. Darbhanga Raj ke gigantic zamindari exploitation aur kisanon par lagaye gaye bedardi abwabs ne unhein agitated kiya. Ve shuruat se Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ke intellectual inner-circle ke pivotal member bane jinhone peasant agitations ko investigative journalism ka strong support diya.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Radical Peasant Journalism, General Secretary of BPKS, Darbhanga Peasant Resistance, Anti-Colonial Mobilization
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: Jamuna Karjee ne Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha ke organizational nerve-center ko manage kiya. Unhone North Bihar mein Darbhanga Raj ke estate officers ke khilaf lagatar agitation organize kiye. 1940 mein unhone Patna se revolutionary Hindi weekly 'Hunkar' shuru kiya. Jab British sarkar ne kisan patrikas par pre-censorship lagayi, Karjee ne fearless investigative reports likhin jismein police excesses aur bureaucratic corruption ko expose kiya gaya. Unki lekhani ke chalte unhein multiple sedition warrants aur continuous surveillance ka saamna karna pada.

institutions_or_initiatives: General Secretary, Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha
famous_works_or_edicts: Kisanon Ki Bipatti
Darbhanga Raj Ka Shoshan
Editorials on Bakasht Rights in Hunkar
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Jamuna Karjee ka sabse bada institutional contribution 'Hunkar' ko pure desh ka premier peasant weekly banana tha. Unhone 'Kisanon Ki Bipatti' pustak likh kar Bihar ke bataidaron (sharecroppers) ki arthik sthiti ka pramanik data pesh kiya. Unki journalism ne rural agrarian realities ko national political agenda par lakar khada kiya.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kisan sangharshon ko dhardaar shabdon se lead karne ke karan unhein 'Kisan Patrakarita ka Senani' kaha gaya.
1940 mein Swami Sahajanand ke sath milkar Patna se 'Hunkar' journal ka publication establish karna.
Pusa aur Samastipur ke kisan library networks unki smriti ko preserve karte hain.
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ke prasiddha kisan samachar patra 'Hunkar' ke mukhya sampadak aur sansthapak kaun the? (Jamuna Karjee)'.

name: Babu Sheetla Sahay (बाबू शीतला सहाय)
popular_title: Founding Pillar of Bihar Kisan Sabha
qualifying_benchmark: Pioneer General Secretary of Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (1929), Architect of Early Agrarian Resolutions

birth_and_roots.birth_place: Patna / Shahabad region, Bihar
birth_and_roots.background_context: Babu Sheetla Sahay ka janam Central Bihar ke ek nationalist, legal background wale Kayastha parivar mein hua tha. Patna College aur Patna Law College se shiksha lene ke baad ve civil rights aur kisan welfare movements se jud gaye. 1920s ke dauran jab Bihar mein zamindaron ki lobby Congress par dominant thi, Sheetla Sahay ne legal aur organizational drafting ke zariye kisanon ka independent platform banane ki policy banayi. Ve Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ke shuruati closest operational architects mein se the.

major_contributions_and_role.key_areas: Foundation of Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS, 1929), Legal Advocacy for Indebted Peasants, Assembly Representations
major_contributions_and_role.detailed_role: November 1929 mein Sonepur mela mein jab Swami Sahajanand Saraswati ne Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) ka gathan kiya, tab Babu Sheetla Sahay ko iska First/Early General Secretary (Sachiv) banaya gaya tha. Unhone Kisan Sabha ka pehla formal constitution aur charter of demands draft kiya. Unhone tenancy reforms, reduction of rent aur illegal cesses ke abolition par rigorous representations banaye jo government ke samne submit kiye gaye. Unhone rural kisan sabha units ko administrative legal representation diya.

institutions_or_initiatives: Founding General Secretary, Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (1929)
famous_works_or_edicts: Constitution of Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (1929)
Resolutions on Abolition of Abwabs
organizations_and_literary_works.explanation: Sheetla Sahay ka primary contribution institutional drafting tha. Unke draft kiye gaye charters ne yeh establish kiya ki Kisan Sabha koi unguided rebellion nahi balki ek structural constitutional class-movement hai. Unke tay kiye gaye organizational rules ke chalte BPKS pure Bharat ki sabse badi provincial kisan organization bankar ubhri.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kisan Sabha ke structural setup ko build karne ke karan unhein 'Kisan Sabha ke Sangathan Shilpi' ke roop mein dekha gaya.
November 1929 Sonepur convention mein BPKS ke foundational platform aur executive committee ka announcement.
Bihar State Archives mein unke hastlikhit kisan sabha records aur minutes sanrakshit hain.
BPSC History & Peasant Movements: '1929 mein Sonepur mein sthapit Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha ke pratham sachiv/sanchalakon mein kaun the? (Babu Sheetla Sahay)'.
